title: Flock-Powered Police Chiefs Stalking Women Shows Why Warrants Are Needed
summary: An investigative report revealing how Flock license plate recognition cameras were misused by police chiefs to track and stalk women, exposing serious privacy vulnerabilities in surveillance technology without warrant requirements.
problem_solved: This article exposes a critical misuse case rather than solving a problem, demonstrating why warrant requirements are essential for license plate tracking data access.
why_valuable: Highlights the dangerous potential for abuse when surveillance data is accessible without proper legal oversight, prompting important discussions about privacy protections in law enforcement technology.
